question: When the Chauhans tried to expand towards the west and east, from whom did they face opposition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chalukyas of Gujarat and Gahadavalas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chauhans**, historically known as the **Chahamanas**, were a powerful Indian dynasty that ruled parts of the present-day states of **Rajasthan**, **Haryana**, and **Delhi**.
 
• During the **12th century**, the Chahamanas attempted to expand their territorial control beyond their traditional base in **Ajmer** and **Delhi**.
 
• As they tried to expand towards the **west**, they encountered stiff opposition from the **Chalukyas of Gujarat** (also known as the **Solankis**). The conflict was primarily over the control of the border regions of **Rajasthan** and the fertile lands of **Gujarat**.
